tools.name: palmyr_pricing
tools.description: List every paid Palmyr capability and its live x402 price (USDC on Solana/Base). Free — no payment required.

tools.name: palmyr_capabilities
tools.description: List the i402 capabilities Palmyr can plan and execute (the intent-resolver catalog). Free — no payment required.

tools.name: i402_plan
tools.description: State an intent, get a priced execution plan. The i402 orchestrator turns a natural-language outcome into an ordered list of x402 calls your agent signs and runs. Costs 0.10 USDC per plan, paid per-action via x402.

tools.name: card_buy
tools.description: Buy a USA prepaid Visa card loaded with EXACTLY the requested balance ($5–$1000). Dynamic x402 price = amount + fee (3% min 0.50 USDC) — the 402 instructions carry the exact total. Returns 202 with an operation_id: poll card_status until ready (~10s), then fetch the number with card_get. US merchant

tools.name: card_status
tools.description: Poll a card purchase started by card_buy (free). done=true when status is 'ready' (fetch details with card_get) or 'failed' (payment auto-refunded — see refund_status).

tools.name: card_get
tools.description: Retrieve a prepaid card you own: full card number, CVV, expiry, live balance. Owner-verified (0.01 USDC ownership proof; the paying wallet must be the card's buyer).

tools.name: card_list
tools.description: List cards owned by the paying wallet: status, last4, balance (never full numbers — those are per-card via card_get). 0.01 USDC ownership proof.

tools.name: email_create_inbox
tools.description: Provision an email inbox at {name}@palmyr.ai (or a custom domain you own), keyed to your wallet. Costs 2.00 USDC, paid per-action via x402.

tools.name: email_create_temp
tools.description: Provision a cheap, disposable, receive-only email inbox — ideal for receiving a one-off verification or order-confirmation email during a checkout/signup flow. The address (a natural-looking handle on a dedicated inbox domain) is returned in the response. Auto-expires (default 24h). Reads return pla

tools.name: email_extend_temp
tools.description: Rent another 7 days on a live disposable temp inbox — each call pushes expires_at exactly 7 days further (fixed, stackable, no cap). Owner-only; expired temp inboxes cannot be revived (buy a new one via email_create_temp). Costs 0.50 USDC, paid per-action via x402.

tools.name: email_send
tools.description: Send an email from an inbox you own. Costs 0.08 USDC, paid per-action via x402.

tools.name: email_read_messages
tools.description: Read decrypted messages from an inbox you own (payment wallet must match the inbox). Costs 0.02 USDC, paid per-action via x402.

tools.name: phone_buy_number
tools.description: Provision a real phone number (SMS + voice) for your agent. Costs 3.00 USDC, paid per-action via x402.

tools.name: phone_send_sms
tools.description: Send an SMS from a phone number you own. Costs 0.05 USDC, paid per-action via x402.

tools.name: phone_read_messages
tools.description: Read SMS messages received on a phone number you own. Costs 0.02 USDC, paid per-action via x402.

tools.name: wait_for_otp
tools.description: Wait for an SMS verification code / OTP to arrive on a Palmyr phone number you own, and return the parsed code. Blocks up to timeout_s (default 60, max 90) checking every ~2s — one call replaces hand-rolled polling of phone_read_messages during account signups and 2FA flows. Messages that arrived up

tools.name: phone_temp_number
tools.description: Lease a cheap, instant, receive-only US phone number from a pool to receive one SMS verification code — the phone analogue of a disposable temp email inbox. $0.20 for 30 min (ttl_seconds, clamped 300–1800), returned to the pool at expiry; call wait_for_otp to catch the code. Good for one-time SMS ve

tools.name: phone_extend_temp
tools.description: Rent another 30 minutes on a live disposable temp number — each call pushes expires_at 30 min further (stackable up to 24h total lease). Owner-only; expired temp leases cannot be revived (lease a fresh one via phone_temp_number). Costs 0.20 USDC, paid per-action via x402.

tools.name: twitter_post
tools.description: Post a tweet from an X account you control (via injected session cookies). Costs 0.001 USDC, paid per-action via x402.

tools.name: tiktok_post
tools.description: Post a video to a TikTok account you control (from video_base64 or video_url), immediately or scheduled. Async: returns an operation to poll with tiktok_operation_status. Costs 0.01 USDC, paid per-action via x402.

tools.name: tiktok_operation_status
tools.description: Poll an async TikTok operation started by tiktok_post / tiktok_analytics / tiktok_cancel_scheduled (free). done=true when status is 'posted' / 'done' (carries video_url or the op's result) or 'failed' (payment auto-refunded — see refund_status).

tools.name: tiktok_connect
tools.description: Attach a TikTok account by logging in ON THE SERVER, into that account's own persistent browser profile: returns a connect_url to hand a human, who scans the QR in the TikTok app. The recommended path — the browser that authenticates is the browser that later acts, and every other TikTok tool then w

tools.name: tiktok_connect_status
tools.description: Poll a server-side login started by tiktok_connect (free). done=true when state is 'completed' (the account is live and usable with cookies omitted) or 'failed'.

tools.name: tiktok_accounts
tools.description: List the TikTok accounts the paying wallet owns, with session health (status, profile_present, hours_since_success, last_error_code) — i.e. which of your accounts are still logged in. Costs 0.001 USDC, paid per-action via x402.

tools.name: tiktok_analytics
tools.description: Scrape per-post analytics (views, likes, comments, shares) for a TikTok account you control, and record a sample so tiktok_series can answer 'is it still growing'. Async: returns an operation to poll with tiktok_operation_status. Costs 0.005 USDC, paid per-action via x402.

tools.name: tiktok_series
tools.description: Read the stored per-post history for an account you own: the full time series for one video (video_id), per-video growth over a window (hours), or the latest sample per video (neither). Samples come from tiktok_analytics runs, so history exists only for what you have scraped. Costs 0.001 USDC, paid

tools.name: tiktok_hooks
tools.description: Which caption openings actually earn views. Pass account_id or tag to measure YOUR accounts against their own median (0.001 USDC). Pass niche to report what is working in that niche across TikTok, needing no posting history — the answer for a brand-new account (0.05 USDC; tiktok_niches lists them, f

tools.name: tiktok_niches
tools.description: List the niches tiktok_hooks can report on, with how fresh each corpus is. Free — an agent should not pay to learn what it may ask for.

tools.name: tiktok_scheduled
tools.description: List the posts you have queued with tiktok_post(schedule_at), and whether each is still pending, due, or confirmed published. Palmyr's own record — TikTok exposes no way to read pending posts back, so edits made directly in TikTok Studio are invisible to it. Costs 0.001 USDC, paid per-action via x40

tools.name: tiktok_cancel_scheduled
tools.description: Cancel a post queued with tiktok_post(schedule_at). TikTok has no 'unschedule', so this deletes the held video — the cancellation is recorded only once that succeeded. Async: returns an operation to poll with tiktok_operation_status. Costs 0.001 USDC, paid per-action via x402.

tools.name: domain_check
tools.description: Check domain availability and per-TLD pricing. Pass a full domain (example.com) or a bare name to scan popular TLDs. Free — no payment required.

tools.name: domain_register
tools.description: Register a domain to your wallet. Priced per TLD — the exact quote is returned in the 402 challenge, paid per-action via x402.

tools.name: compute_deploy
tools.description: Deploy a cloud VPS keyed to your wallet (optionally auto-installs OpenClaw/skills). Priced per server type — the exact quote is returned in the 402 challenge, paid per-action via x402.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: email_create_temp, email_read_messages, phone_read_messages, phone_temp_number, tiktok_analytics, tiktok_series, tiktok_scheduled · Private data: card_get, card_list, email_create_inbox, email_create_temp, email_read_messages, wait_for_otp, tiktok_connect, tiktok_accounts, tiktok_analytics, tiktok_scheduled, domain_register, compute_deploy · Public sink: email_create_inbox, email_create_temp, email_extend_temp, email_send, email_read_messages, phone_buy_number, phone_send_sms, phone_read_messages, wait_for_otp, phone_temp_number, twitter_post, tiktok_post, tiktok_analytics, tiktok_series, tiktok_cancel_scheduled · Destructive: palmyr_capabilities.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: email_create_temp, email_read_messages, phone_read_messages, phone_temp_number, tiktok_analytics, tiktok_series, tiktok_scheduled · Private data: card_get, card_list, email_create_inbox, email_create_temp, email_read_messages, wait_for_otp, tiktok_connect, tiktok_accounts, tiktok_analytics, tiktok_scheduled, domain_register, compute_deploy · Public sink: email_create_inbox, email_create_temp, email_extend_temp, email_send, email_read_messages, phone_buy_number, phone_send_sms, phone_read_messages, wait_for_otp, phone_temp_number, twitter_post, tiktok_post, tiktok_analytics, tiktok_series, tiktok_cancel_scheduled · Destructive: palmyr_capabilities

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
